note: Curated candidate pool for FEAT-OSS-INVENTORY-CAD round 1 (function-point full sweep). tier: 1=kernel-grade B-rep/NURBS/robust-solid kernel, 2=framework/library carrying a real kernel or exact-arithmetic geometry, 3=mesh/repair/exchange/IGA specialisation. Every entry is verified live by tools/oss_inventory_cad/survey.py (git commit SHA + tree + license file); entries that fail to clone are recorded as status=clone_failed, never silently dropped.

repos.why: Reference open B-rep kernel; every downstream open CAD app is measured against it.
Production parametric CAD application; owns the part-design/loft/defeaturing workflows TensorCAD would need.
Guaranteed-manifold boolean kernel; the licence-clean candidate for GAP-CAD-003.
Exact-predicate reference implementations for arrangement/boolean/meshing primitives.
Constraint solver isolated in a small codebase; the only permissively-licensed Newton solver of this class.
IGA reference: spline basis construction from CAD patches for analysis (GAP-CAD-014).
Section-based lofting engine closest in spirit to hull-form generation.
Python fluent API over OCCT; defines the agent-facing ergonomics TensorCAD should match.
Successor API with explicit topology (Vertex/Edge/Face/Solid) selection; useful for topology-naming semantics.
Thin Python binding to OCCT; the reference for what a Python-side B-rep surface looks like.
Minimal browser CAD; small enough to read end-to-end for kernel-call sequencing.
Pure-Python CAD kernel that keeps its own mesh-based B-rep (madcad); the closest permissive-licence peer for a Python-native kernel.
Pure-Python NURBS with knot refinement/degree elevation - directly comparable to tensorcad.nurbs.
Industrial spline library (SINTEF); intersection and approximation routines.
Implicit/F-Rep CSG evaluated to meshes; the architectural peer of tensorcad.csg.
Differentiable geometry queries on GPU; reference for later differentiable-geometry work.
Python mesh workhorse; repair/watertight/boolean fallbacks that TensorCAD is currently missing.
Bundled exact-ish mesh boolean + repair + tetgen wrapper; a coverage map for F03/F08/F09.
Header-only geometry processing algorithms with citable papers per routine.
B-rep driven volume mesher with prism boundary layers (F08).
Guaranteed-manifold repair of arbitrary triangle soups (F09 gap).
Reference implementations of the standard repair/decimation filters.
EXPRESS/STEP schema parser - licence-clean route to semantic STEP (F10).
Format-normalising I/O layer; benchmark for what exchange coverage means.
Deliberately included negative control: a nonexistent repository must be recorded as clone_failed by the survey and must not inflate the census count.
Script-driven CSG modeller with its own CGAL-backed CSG evaluator: the direct peer of an agent-authored geometry script.
Modern C++ mesh-processing toolkit built on a half-edge structure; replaces the unreachable OpenMesh entry for F01/F09.
Python bindings to CGAL meshers (tetra + surface + remesh); the licence-clean route to F08 without vendoring CGAL.
